summary_en: Sanwa Holdings will cancel 3.0 million shares on December 11, 2026, representing 1.4% of outstanding shares before cancellation, reducing total issued shares to 216.0 million.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 30, 2026, Sanwa Holdings' board of directors resolved to cancel 3.0 million treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled for December 11, 2026. These shares represent 1.4% of outstanding shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, total issued shares will be 216.0 million.
